column1: AI Drawing Composition Detail Template — Weight & Ratio Precision Control Edition v2.4 (Adaptable Across All Models)

Positioning: a quality-control workbench for single/multi-character image generation, covering five syntax families — natural-language flow (Flux/DALL-E 3/SD3), conversational image models (GPT-4o/Gemini), MJ/Niji, SD, and domestic API models (Jimeng/Kling/Doubao/Tongyi Wanxiang). "Adaptable" means the setting layer (character anchors / composition / validation) is universal across models, while the syntax layer is adapted per model. v2.4 (vs v2.3) adds: the posture-emotion reference table (Section D; temperament → pose/gaze/center-of-gravity optional mapping) and a posture-difference field for two-character interaction. v2.3 added: the domestic API syntax flow, the DALL-E 3 deprecation note, and the honest adaptability framing.
